patch_description: This crossover retains the strongest-performing Möbius-ladder CZ connectivity while merging the collective RY and RZ layers into one shared circuit parameter. The fixed entanglers provide local and long-range correlation mixing, while the tied angle imposes strong few-shot regularization. This reduces the circuit to one distinct ansatz parameter—three total parameters including gain and bias—improving parameter economy and aiming to reduce overfitting without removing either rotation axis.
